results.title: Amid oil squeeze, mounting economic pressure, Bangladesh seeks fresh $4.5 billion IMF loan
results.description: After exiting its previous IMF programme in May, Dhaka is seeking new financing as slowing growth, high inflation, banking-sector distress and rising energy costs strain its economy.
